loss_scale.signed: every signed seat dEV and node regret excess (point raw residual and each bootstrap replicate) is stored unchanged for diagnostics
loss_scale.primary_Delta_raw: Delta_raw = max(0, signed loss / excess) per primary seat and node
loss_scale.U_k: each replicate loss_r = max(0, signed metric of sigma_r in G_raw,k); U_k = mean(loss_r, r = 1..60)
loss_scale.negative_signed: a negative signed value means no loss detectable within the current raw solve residual / noise; it is never read as a negative residual

wording.pass: Delta_raw,k <= U_k for every primary metric = "converged at current panel resolution" (panel-resolution outer-consistent)
wording.never: not a proof of true fixed-point convergence: U_k is a bootstrap panel-error scale, not a fixed-point bound

execution.step0_only: run step 0 (450 postflop at R_0, raw solve, U_0, stop decision) and report; step 1 is not started automatically
execution.capped_board: any board above 0.300% pot at the cap stops the step decision and is reported
